name: free-photoeditor
description: Free Photo Editor by Bhawesh Tibrewal: a fast, small photo editor that runs fully in the browser.
author: Bhawesh Tibrewal (https://bhaweshtibrewal.com)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.e2e: npm run build && vitest run --config packages/web/vitest.e2e.config.ts
